description: SDPA forward over hipkernel:flydsl_sdpa_cdna_decode, FlyDSL's generic attention kernel in its split-KV decode mode (packs/FlydslSdpaCdnaDecodeNative.cpp and FlydslSdpaCdnaCommon.hpp; the 24 gfx950 objects of descriptors/FlyDSL/sdpa_cdna_decode/gfx950/manifest.json): the keys split across workgroups, the query heads of a K/V head packed with their positions into one row tile, a merge kernel in the same object. The graph matcher is the one of the prefill engine (flydslSdpaCdnaGraphMatches is registered under all three CDNA engines), so this space draws the same graph features and only the head sizes, the sequence lengths and the features the decode catalog lacks differ from SdpaFwd/FlydslCdna. Both 16-bit types, each operand BSHD or BHSD (layout_q, layout_kv, layout_o; K and V share one layout, an object reads V through K's strides only when it is a qk_mask one), grouped-query heads Hq = hkv * group with groups up to 128 (the packed rows are group * seqlen_q, grid x = batch * ceil(rows / block_m) * hkv). (head size, V head size): the shipped decode objects are the exact head sizes 64, 128 (bm64) and 256 (bm128, waves per EU 1) with V the same, and one MLA bucket, head_dim 1024 with head_dim_v 512, qk_mask 1 and dv_split 4: it serves any Q/K head size up to 1024 that is a multiple of 8 with a V of exactly 512 (so Q/K from 512, the V width the matcher needs not to exceed). The draws cover 64, 128, 256 and the MLA sizes 512, 576, 640, 768 and 1024 over 512. A head size of 96 (a multiple of 8, so the prefill engine's qkm1 objects take it), 1 draw in 24, is the decline probe: the decode catalog has no qk_mask object below the MLA bucket. seqlen_q is mostly small (1 is a boundary, drawn half the time; up to 128) and seqlen_kv up to 8192 drives the key split: candidateSplits divides the keys into min(2 * compute_units / grid_x, ceil(seqlen_kv / 64) / 4, 64) splits, so more than one split needs at least 8 key tiles of 64 (a key length above 448) and a grid_x no larger than the compute-unit count, which a long key length and a small batch reach. kv_align is the decode family's constant 0, so every key length is served. Masks, stats and the diagonal are as in SdpaFwd/FlydslCdna: none, top-left causal, bottom-right causal and a sliding window by left_bound with right_bound wr, resolved by maskFor to a runtime window_lo and diagonal offset (the decode family's any_diagonal constant is 1, and only the dual-wave family declines a window); a window with no right bound declines and is not drawn. Query rows that would see no key are excluded (the reference gives them a zero row and an LSE of -inf). stats (off, off, on) adds the FP32 log-sum-exp tensor [b, hq, sq, 1], which the merge kernel writes when the keys are split. No bias is drawn: no decode object has has_bias, so every attn_mask graph declines (SdpaFwd/FlydslDecodeProbe draws it). The sink1 objects for head sizes 64 and 128 are not drawn either: the references grade only a FLOAT sink and the matcher takes only one in the query's dtype (the probe space draws the pair). scale is 2^-64 to 2^20 (isServableScale: positive and at most MAX_SOFTMAX_SCALE = 2^20, the bound at which every FlyDSL SDPA family stays inside f32; 2^20 itself is the upper boundary). The domain axis fills Q, K and V as in the other gfx950 SdpaFwd spaces (large uses scale 8, nan and inf go on V alone at 2^-12 of its elements, only where no mask applies and for an infinity only for bfloat16 with a scale at most 1) and V keeps the range of Q and K: config/hipkernel_flydsl_sdpa.toml grades O of every gauntlet suite by an allclose with atol and rtol 2^-5 instead of the common 1e-2 tolerance, as the engine TOML of SdpaFwd/Gfx950Dense does, and that tolerance was derived from the rounding of P in the bfloat16 P.V product, not measured on these kernels. alignment declares one alignment on Q, K, V and O (and on the bias and the LSE tensor); the shared graph matcher needs 16 bytes from Q, K, V, O and the bias (declaredAlignmentCovers), so alignments 1 to 8 decline whatever the shape, 4 of 9 draws; placement puts the pointers at exactly that alignment (exact) or misaligns Q (placement_uid 1) below it, which passes only if the backend rejects it (under, drawn as exact at alignment 1). The cost ceiling b*hq*sq*skv*dq <= 2**31 is the one of the other SdpaFwd spaces (GPU reference cost ceiling, RFC 0023 section 14, measured on gfx950). Every claim above is what the pack code and the shipped manifest say; no case of this space had been run on a device when it was written.

derive.stride_q: [sq*hq*dq, dq, hq*dq, 1] if layout_q == 'bshd' else [hq*sq*dq, sq*dq, dq, 1]
derive.stride_k: [skv*hkv*dq, dq, hkv*dq, 1] if layout_kv == 'bshd' else [hkv*skv*dq, skv*dq, dq, 1]
derive.stride_v: [skv*hkv*dv, dv, hkv*dv, 1] if layout_kv == 'bshd' else [hkv*skv*dv, skv*dv, dv, 1]
derive.stride_o: [sq*hq*dv, dv, hq*dv, 1] if layout_o == 'bshd' else [hq*sq*dv, sq*dv, dv, 1]
derive.right: 0 if mask in ['causal_top_left', 'causal_bottom_right'] else (wr if mask == 'window' else None)
derive.rows_see_a_key: (right == None or diag + right >= 0) and (left == None or sq + diag - left <= skv - 1)
derive.nf_ok: not masked and not (domain == 'inf' and (dtype == 'half' or scale > 1))
derive.dom_kind: 'fixed' if domain == 'constant' else ('special' if dom_poison else ('free' if domain in ['default', 'narrow', 'wide', 'positive', 'nan', 'inf'] else domain))
derive.dom_lo: -0.01 if domain == 'narrow' else (-8 if domain == 'wide' else (0.25 if domain == 'positive' else (0.5 if domain == 'constant' else -1)))
derive.dom_hi: 0.01 if domain == 'narrow' else (8 if domain == 'wide' else (4 if domain == 'positive' else (0.5 if domain == 'constant' else 1)))
derive.eff_placement: 'exact' if placement == 'under' and alignment < 2 else placement

constraints.reason: a query row with no key under the mask has a zero output row and an LSE of -inf in the references (CpuFpReferenceSdpa.hpp, 'fully masked rows'), which the kernel is not described to define (SdpaFwd/FlydslCdnaProbe draws it as bottom_right_sq_gt_skv); bottom-right causal needs sq <= skv, and a window must reach a key from every row

maskFor (FlydslSdpaCdnaCommon.hpp) declines a diagonal past Skv - Sq, right > skv - sq - align: the causal objects mask the last KV tile's padding with the same compare, which holds only while every row's diagonal stays inside the keys, so top-left causal needs sq <= skv and a band to the right of the diagonal needs room for it, and bottom-right takes only right 0. SdpaFwd/FlydslDecodeProbe draws top_left_sq_gt_skv and window_right_over

GPU reference cost ceiling (RFC 0023 section 14), kept at 2**31 on measurement (gfx950, 2026-11-02, measure_oracle_cost.py): the largest rung, cost 2**31, ran on the GPU lane in 458 ms (278 ms at 2**21), fit reference_ms = 278 + 8.4e-8 * cost over 6 rungs, r2 0.9995; 60 s is reached only at about 7.1e11. The ceiling is not the budget limit; raising it would make fuzz cases slower
